@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M376F14G9B9QWNG0TTA6VRKT
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'AgentRegistry: marketplace layers, watch, layerUpdates, onReload, AgentReloadReport'
+---
+## What
+Layer 2, marketplace and reload part (plan.md §4.1, §6.1, §10, §12).
+
+- In `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentRegistry.swift` add `init(marketplaces: any MarketplaceLayerProviding, stack:variables:watch:)`. The layers are `marketplace[0] < … < marketplace[n] < local layers`, from `provider.marketplaceLayers()`. Each marketplace definition keeps its `MarketplaceProvenance`.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentRegistry+Reload.swift`:
+  - Rebuild on a `DotfolderWatcher` change when `watch` is true, on each `layerUpdates` value, and on `reload()`. A burst gives one final catalog.
+  - `public var onReload: AsyncStream<AgentCatalog>` publishes each new catalog.
+- Create `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/Registry/AgentReloadReport.swift`: agent count, model-visible count, marketplace counts, slash-command names (empty until the command task fills it), diagnostic counts by severity.
+- Look at `../FoundationModelsSkills/Sources/FoundationModelsSkills/Registry/SkillsRegistry.swift` for the same wiring.
+- Verify (plan.md §16): a `file://` source with `path:` gives its folder unchanged.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A fixture provider of the §6.1 shape gives its agents with provenance.
+- [ ] A project agent with the same name wins over a marketplace agent, with an advisory.
+- [ ] A marketplace layer with no `agents/` folder gives no agents and no error.
+- [ ] A `layerUpdates` value gives a new catalog on `onReload`.
+- [ ] Add, change, and remove of a watched file each give a new catalog; a burst of writes gives one final catalog with the last state.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRegistryMarketplaceTests.swift` with a fixture `MarketplaceLayerProviding` (use `MarketplaceFixtures`).
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/AgentRegistryReloadTests.swift` with a temporary directory and the watcher, and `AgentReloadReportTests.swift`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "AgentRegistryMarketplace|AgentRegistryReload|AgentReloadReport"`. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
